get_content: Today I planted a row of trees on the left side of my planet, and by evening they lit up just like the stars. In that moment, I suddenly wanted to tell you: I hope your planet is always lit by such a gentle light, too.
I just heard some really cheerful sounds coming from the Galactic Bazaar. Sounds like a bunch of people are dancing.

I took a stroll through the Bazaar and didn't really do anything. I just watched the crowds drift by and listened to the laughter and chatter. There's a comforting warmth in the hustle and bustle of everyday life, and I wanted to share that cozy feeling with you.
Have you ever felt lost or confused about anything? For me, I really enjoy living on my planet. It feels like my very own personal journey.
Goodman said the Bazaar was super quiet today, and it made me a little sad. I don't want quiet, I just want some company.
No idea why, but there's always a crowd in the Galactic Bazaar spamming emotes. It's honestly pretty fun to watch.
Yunguo is sooooooo cute! I love her!
Anyone wanna come hang out on my planet? I need more friends!!!
To whoever gets this Star Note: I hope you're doing well and finding a little happiness each day. And if things ever feel hard, just remember there's a little planet here that belongs to you.
Nalo! I love you so much! I'm getting Untamed coffee every day from now on! Forever!!
Writing Star Notes again today. I got so many nice replies to yesterday's. It honestly made my day. Hope this brings you a bit of happiness too, whenever you read it.
Whatever you do, just remember to eat well, go to bed early, and don't stay up too late.
Today was my first day playing Petit Planet. It felt so long, and I got to do so many things. I guess time really does stretch out here
A friend grew this huge corn today. I'm so jealous. Now I keep looking at my own field, hoping I'll get one just as big tomorrow.
I hope whoever reads this message has a wonderfully happy day today

Still recovering from my friend's terrible joke today. He asked, "What do you get when a chicken lays an egg on top of a barn?" Go on, guess... Give up? The answer is... 
...
...
...
an egg roll!
Whoever gets this, do you ever wonder why we even have exams?!!!! If you feel the same, write back lolol
I swear I catch more fish when I've got music on!
I love eating the vegetables Yunguo grows, and it's totally not because she's adorable.
I made so many new friends at the bazaar yesterday. Everyone was super friendly.
I really wish I could live on my own planet forever.
